evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep never asks 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — moves directly into estimate delivery. Mandy does surface concerns mid-call (binding quote, packing material quantity, truck size) but rep is reactive, not proactive.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were surfaced in Section 2 because there was no Section 2 agenda ask. Concerns emerged organically later (packing material count, binding vs. estimate) but rep does attempt follow-up ('I'll get back to you on that').
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives range ($11,950–$12,330) and discloses travel fee, overnight fee, packing materials, and time-based charging model. Lacks personalization to this customer's stated concerns (e.g., no mention of how the three-day structure addresses their prep needs or timeline).
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Call ends with 'I'll send you the email for your personalized estimate shortly' and 'thank you so much for picking up my call. Take care.' No direct ask: 'Would you like our help with your move?'
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep opens with 'I already have your personal estimate ready in here' — no framing of the call structure, time commitment, or promise of a dependable quote. No wait for customer agreement before diving into estimate.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Trip fee and overnight fee mentioned early. Time-based charging and 'we will charge you for the total time consumed' stated. Does not use '2.5-hour minimum' or '15-minute increments' language. No 'not a guess' commitment framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked at any point. After estimate delivery, rep asks 'does everything make sense so far?' but this is a comprehension check, not a 'does that feel fair?' pricing pause.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. Deposit clarified at end ('no deposit required'), but no rate-lock or price guarantee language.

top_strength: Nicole handled Mandy's detailed probing on packing materials and estimate composition with patience, offering to send a text breakdown and committing to follow up on wardrobe box counts — demonstrating willingness to support a customer's need for clarity.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire Section 2 agenda discovery and never asked for the business explicitly — Nicole pivoted from estimate straight to email follow-up without confirming Mandy's intent to book or addressing core move-day concerns that would have surfaced in a proper agenda.
